additional_concerns: The constant true result implements the expressly selected independent-footnote reading only. Footnote 5's unqualified wording supports that rival reading, while paragraph 14 expressly conditions demonstration on an SFC request. The representation does not resolve their relationship and must not be presented as establishing the sole legally correct trigger.

TRUE_IS_SATISFIED must be interpreted here as trigger activation only. It establishes neither completed demonstration, compliance with paragraphs 10–13, smart-contract assurance, SFC satisfaction nor overdue status.

Complete paragraphs 10–13, footnote 2 and the applicable Appendix factors are not supplied. They would be needed to assess substantive fulfilment, but their absence does not itself prevent comparison with this narrowly defined trigger question.

Paragraph 16 separately conditions obtaining a satisfactory legal opinion on an SFC request. The supplied intermediary paragraphs 17–18 impose activity-specific due-diligence and controls expectations; neither provision establishes footnote 5's independent trigger.
The supplied structural PASS and retrieval results do not establish legal support or settle the competing readings.
